# llmmend

> Fix what your LLM returns: extract and repair JSON from model replies, turn streaming responses from Anthropic, OpenAI (Chat Completions and Responses), Gemini and OpenAI-compatible servers into one event format, split text into token-sized chunks, build prompts that untrusted input cannot break out of, price calls from their usage, and tell which errors are worth retrying. Zero dependencies; Node 20+, Bun, Deno, browsers and edge runtimes.

Install with `npm i llmmend`. Import from `llmmend/json`, `llmmend/sse`, `llmmend/chunk`, `llmmend/prompt`, `llmmend/cost` or `llmmend/retry`, or from the root: both are tree-shakeable. `extractJson` never throws on bad input: check `res.ok`, then read `res.value` or `res.error`. Streams take a `fetch` `Response` and detect the Provider by default.

## llmmend/json

- [extractJson](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#extractjson): `extractJson(text, options?)` finds the JSON in a Reply, repairs it and, given a schema, validates it.
- [extractJsonAsync](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#extractjsonasync): The same as `extractJson`, for schemas that validate asynchronously.
- [extractJsonOrThrow](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#extractjsonorthrow): Returns the value or throws `LlmmendJsonError`, whose `code` is the `error` above, with `issues` and, for `schema_mismatch`, `schemaIssues`.
- [extractAllJson](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#extractalljson): Every Candidate in the Reply, in order.
- [repairJson](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#repairjson): Repairs JSON text and returns valid JSON as a string, plus the Issues fixed.
- [parsePartialJson](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#parsepartialjson): Reads JSON that is still arriving, for progressive UIs.
- [extractTag](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#extracttag): `extractTag(text, name, { pick? })` finds a tag such as `<answer>…</answer>` in a Reply and returns its text, trimmed at its edges.
- [extractAllTags](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#extractalltags): Every closed top-level tag in the Reply, in order, as `{ name, value, attributes, start, end }`; `start` and `end` span the whole tag.
- [extractCodeBlocks](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#extractcodeblocks): `extractCodeBlocks(text, { lang? })` returns every fenced code block in a Reply, in order, as `{ lang, info, code, start, end, complete }`
- [Issues](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#issues): Every result lists what was done to the Reply, in order.

## llmmend/sse

- [parseSSE](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#parsesse): A [WHATWG-compliant](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html) server-sent events parser.
- [streamLlm](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#streamllm): `streamLlm(source, { provider?, signal? })` turns a Provider's stream into one sequence of LLM events.
- [LLM events](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#llm-events): `index` is the Block: text, reasoning and each tool call get their own number, the same way for every Provider.
- [streamText](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#streamtext): Yields only the answer's text.
- [collectText](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#collecttext): Reads the whole stream and returns `{ text, stopReason, usage?, responseId?, toolCalls }`, with the last usage snapshot.
- [streamJson](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#streamjson): Streams a Reply that contains JSON.
- [streamToolCalls](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#streamtoolcalls): Streams an answer with tool calls, for UIs that render a call while the model writes it.
- [sseResponse](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#sseresponse): `sseResponse(source, init?)` streams an async iterable as server-sent events, in a `Response` with `content-type: text/event-stream`, `cache-control: no-cache` and `x-accel-buffering: no` (so nginx does not hold events back), unless `init` sets them.
- [Custom Provider adapters](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#custom-provider-adapters): An adapter turns each parsed SSE event into zero or more LLM events.

## llmmend/chunk

- [chunkText](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#chunktext): `chunkText(text, options)` splits a text into chunks of at most `maxTokens` tokens and returns `{ text, start, end, tokens, index, oversized?, headings? }[]`.
- [chunkDocuments](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#chunkdocuments): `chunkDocuments(docs, options)` splits several documents with `chunkText` and returns all their chunks in one array.
- [estimateTokens](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#estimatetokens): `estimateTokens(text, { tokenizer? })` estimates tokens without a vocabulary, from the kinds of characters in the text, for OpenAI's `o200k_base` (`'o200k'`, the default), Claude (`'claude'`) or Gemini (`'gemini'`).
- [truncateToTokens](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#truncatetotokens): `truncateToTokens(text, max, { from?, ellipsis?, countTokens?, tokenizer? })` shortens a text to at most `max` tokens without splitting a grapheme cluster.

## llmmend/prompt

- [safePrompt](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#safeprompt): `safePrompt` is a template tag that returns a string.
- [escapeTags](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#escapetags): `escapeTags(text, names)` is the escaping `safePrompt` applies, for prompts built without it.

## llmmend/cost

- [estimateCost](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#estimatecost): `estimateCost(usage, prices)` returns `{ total, input, cacheRead, cacheWrite, output, missing? }`: what each part of the call cost, unrounded, in the unit of the prices.
- [toUsage](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#tousage): `toUsage(raw)` turns a Provider’s raw `usage` into `LlmUsage` with the same rules as the streams, recognising it by its fields: Anthropic (cached tokens added to `input_tokens`), OpenAI Chat Completions and compatible APIs (`prompt_tokens`), OpenAI Responses (`input_tokens_details`) and Gemini (`usageMetadata`: thoughts count as output).

## llmmend/retry

- [classifyError](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#classifyerror): `classifyError(error)` returns `{ kind, retryable, retryAfter?, status?, message }` for a failed model call.

## Reference

- [Errors](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#errors): Every error llmmend throws extends `LlmmendError`, which has a `code`
- [Versioning](https://github.com/nightlightmare/llmmend/blob/main/docs/api.md#versioning): The unions you `switch` on (`Issue['code']`, `ExtractError`, `StopReason`, `LlmEvent['type']`, `LlmmendError['code']`) are closed, so TypeScript checks your `switch`.
